notes.title: OVR Toolkit & How to Fix Height Issues
notes.content:
The developers at Forbidden Art recognize that you want to share your experience playing our games with others.

We wanted to share a few settings to make your experience smoother.

We've gotten a lot of feedback about OVR not working during play, especially if you're using the OVR Toolkit.

In addition, we'd like to share some settings for when your field of view is buried in the floor or higher than your height during gameplay.

[h1]1. OVR Toolkit Setting[/h1]

Enter "SteamVR -> Settings -> OpenXR" and you should see the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/249262f6dc5fcea0d925d09753a2fde900ff0b73.png[/img]

Most Oculus users will have something like the image below.

If you click on "SET STEAMVR AS OPENXR RUNTIME" here, you'll see the

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/9ccfeccdff59774033603aff00af78aa1c8dfcd6.png[/img]

They will be replaced as shown in the image above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/6d3b1108b26f1a05d614e5cd1e22f9ddc900dab1.jpg[/img]

When you subsequently run your game on STEAM, you'll see that the OVR Toolkit is working properly.

[h2]2. Height Setting[/h2]

When you launch the game, you may be set to an incorrect height that does not match your height. Don't worry, this is not a bug in the game, but rather an incorrect device setting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/48b2e63acfeb36dc17888b2554f5a46eed93660b.png[/img]

Put on your VR and enter "SteamVR settings->Developer->Developer Settings" as shown in the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/1276456b9701b412c6721f7d916adb3493add4bb.png[/img]

Select a room in the "Room and Tracking" section and press "Quick Calibrate" to change it to its normal height.
If this doesn't make sense, check out the video below and enjoy the game.

[previewyoutube=uF8IyVbPsIM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Forbidden Art - Patch note (v.1.2.5)
notes.content:
hello
This is AIXLAB, the developer of Forbidden Art.

We continue to experience intermittent issues with the level loading process. 
In previous patches, we were able to fix it by working within the existing system.
However, the same bug continued to occur, so in this patch, we've completely gutted the system and developed a new one.

If you're still experiencing bugs with level loading after version 1.2.5, please let us know through the community.
It will help us improve the game. 
Screenshots or videos of the bug would be especially appreciated.

As always, we're grateful to everyone who plays Forbidden Art.
We apologize to anyone who has experienced bugs with level loading.

notes.title: Forbidden Art: March 25th 2024 Full release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/6cfcd04a2a8f99e817f9a7b6e0057117001a8a36.png[/img]

Hello! 
This is AIXLAB, developers of Forbidden Art.
After almost 4 months of early access, we are finally releasing the full game on Monday, March 25, 2024 at 00:00(PST)!
We've summarized and incorporated feedback from players during the Early Access period. 
We've also prioritized usability updates to make it easier for players to immerse themselves in the game.



[h2]NEW PUZZLES[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/60e97a9dff99ff777606a46084df3c77dbbdefe5.png[/img]

In response to feedback that there weren't enough puzzles, we've added a few more puzzles per zone. Players who previously completed the game on Early Access are welcome to try the new puzzles again!



[h2]ENVIRNONMENT UPDATES[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/7cf5b99df1928789a56ba706bcfcdbd85665ac0c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/30e314ff515658116257d366de0196f76359b9e8.png[/img]

Brightened the lighting a bit in areas where it was not necessary to use a light source for the game's design intent. 
Added some background elements.
Added a killer's animation.



[h2]ADDED WRITABLE DIARY[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35937831/199d0303267531db2fad30333081a746da0c0185.gif[/img]

While it is possible to solve all puzzles without taking notes, we have added note-taking to speed up some sections and for overall player enjoyment and convenience.



[h2]OTHER FIXED AND ADJUSTMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed footstep sounds to sound more natural.
[*] Fixed an issue where players in 'crouch' mode would have to drop lower than shown when passing through height restricted areas.
[*] 'Quick turn' could sometimes cause objects to collide and trigger the sound detector, causing the player to game over. 'Quick turn' no longer cause object collision sounds.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could grab important items in their inventory through walls.
[*] Fixed the sound detector in the office reacting to the sound of the gramophone in the office (this shouldn't cause a game over, but was causing some players to question it).
[*] Changed the save system in J's room to fix an issue that caused certain puzzles to be repeated over and over again.
[*] Fixed candles placed on maps to better catch fire.
[*] Changed options such as Quick turn and sound settings to persist when the game is turned off and on.
[/list]


We hope to provide you with the best quality possible when you play Forbidden Art.
Feedbacks on the game are always welcome.
Thank you!

notes.title: Urgent Notice for Chinese Players of "Forbidden Art" Download Problems
notes.content:
Dear players of << Forbidden Art >>.

We are AIXLAB Games, and we are deeply honored by your support and enthusiasm. Recently we have noticed that some Chinese players have encountered problems when trying to download and start our horror escape VR game << Forbidden Art >>. Players reported that after clicking on the download button, the system shows "download complete", but in fact no files were successfully downloaded. As a result, when trying to launch the game, an error message saying that the exe file is missing appears.

We take this issue very seriously and have been actively looking for a solution. We understand that any inconvenience in your gaming experience may affect your mood and experience, so we are doing our best to fix this technical issue as soon as possible. Our team has already started investigating this issue and will provide an update and solution as soon as possible.

We promise to do everything we can to make sure you can play Forbidden Art as soon as possible.

Please stay tuned to our announcements for updates and progress.
If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to ask your questions in the Steam Community.

Thank you again for your support and understanding. We look forward to having you experience the excitement and fun of Forbidden Art soon.

AIXLAB Games

notes.title: Forbidden Art Coming Friday, November 24!
notes.content:
Hello, AIXLAB Games! ✨

Since 2018, we've been creating and releasing the Haunted House VR series of games, which are only available offline, 
After 2 years and 6 months of development, we have released the early access version of the extreme horror room escape game 🌠 "Forbidden Art".
we are releasing the Early Access version.  Are you ready for Friday, November 24, 2023?

Forbidden Art is a VR game that supports "6m X 6m Room Scale Mode".
The entire game's map is built to fit a 6m X 6m real-world space, and players can actually walk around every room in the game, rather than just pressing buttons on a controller.
players can actually walk around and play in all the spaces in the game.
If players have access to a 6m X 6m play space, we strongly recommend playing in "6m X 6m Room Scale Mode".
Of course, we realize that it's not easy for every player to have a 6m by 6m space, so naturally, we also provide "Controller Movement Mode", which allows players who don't have a space to enjoy "Forbidden Art" in VR without any restrictions.
Use your skills to escape from the dangerous underground space created by a psychopathic killer without getting caught!

notes.title: "Forbidden Art!" - From Escape Rooms to Horror, a New VR Experience Awaits!
notes.content:

notes.title: Forbidden Art : The Masked Artist
notes.content:
Hello AIXLAB community members,

We regret to inform you that the release of our Haunted House VR Ep. Series 1-3 has been delayed. The extensive level and quality upgrades require more time to complete, but we are committed to delivering the best possible experience for our players.

We are excited to announce that "Forbidden Art: The Masked Artist" will be released first, with a planned launch in November 2023. This room escape puzzle game tells the story of a captive trying to escape from a prison after being kidnapped by a murderer. We are working hard to make the game as realistic and immersive as possible.

We kindly ask for your continued interest and support for our projects. Stay tuned for updates on the Steam community news board!

Thank you!

Best regards,
The AIXLAB Team
